description.fun: A little olive that turns the nutrients it makes from sunlight into oil, storing it in the fruit on its head, so it can easily go a week without eating or drinking. It loves dry, sunny places and spends its days sunbathing. Startle it and it squirts oil so bitter it makes you flinch, then runs. Olives are a nod to Spain, the world's biggest olive grower.
description.guide: A Grass and Normal-type olive Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that stores oil in the fruit on its head. Smoliv evolves into Dolliv and then Arboliva.
description.tagline: A sunbathing olive that squirts bitter oil

description.fun: Dolliv has lived alongside people since ancient times, sharing its tasty, fresh-scented oil with them. It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the olives on its head are ripe, and then it leaves human settlements behind and sets off on a journey. It sleeps sitting down with its dress-like body spread around it.
description.guide: The middle stage of Smoliv's line, a Grass and Normal-type Pokémon shaped like a doll in a dress. It may draw on dryads, the tree spirits of Greek myth.
description.tagline: A little olive doll that shares its oil with people

description.fun: A calm, compassionate olive tree that shares its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon. Threaten it, though, and it fires that oil with enough force to smash a boulder. Its peaceful nature may echo the olive branch as a symbol of peace, and in battle it sometimes strikes a pose like an olive wreath.
description.guide: The final evolution of Smoliv, a Grass and Normal-type Pokémon resembling an olive tree, perhaps inspired by the tree-dwelling hamadryads of Greek myth. It shares its nourishing oil with weakened Pokémon.
description.tagline: A gentle olive tree that shares its oil
